statements.t: The restructuring we announced in July reduced our workforce and dedicated contractors by approximately 35% and we expect this to yield approximately $30 million in annualized savings,” said Byron Allen, BuzzFeed Chairman and CEO.
Following a transformative year that included the Allen Family Digital transaction in May and our July restructuring, we are deferring our financial outlook as we continue to integrate these changes.

We have used, and intend to continue to use, the Investor Relations section of our website at investors.buzzfeed.com as a means of disclosing material nonpublic information and for complying with our disclosure obligations under Regulation FD.
There can be no assurance that future developments affecting us will be those that we have anticipated.

(1) We exclude restructuring expenses from our non-GAAP measures because we believe they do not reflect expected future operating expenses, they are not indicative of our core operating performance, and they are not meaningful in comparison to our past operating performance.

We exclude losses associated with early terminations of leases from our non-GAAP measures because we believe they do not reflect expected future operating expenses, they are not indicative of our core operating performance, and they are not meaningful in comparisons to our past operating performance.

(2) developments relating to our competitors and the digital media industry, including overall demand of advertising in the markets in which we operate
(3) demand for our products and services or changes in traffic or engagement with our brands and content
(4) changes in the business and competitive environment in which we and our current and prospective partners and advertisers operate
(7) the benefits of our restructuring (including our expected cost savings)
(8) our success divesting of companies, assets, or brands we sell, or in integrating and supporting the companies we acquire
(9) our success in launching new products or platforms, including any new social media platform
(11) our success in retaining or recruiting, or changes required in, officers, other key employees or directors
(12) use of content creators and on-camera talent and relationships with third parties managing certain of our branded operations outside of the United States
(13) the security of our information technology systems or data
(14) disruption in our service, or by our failure to timely and effectively scale and adapt our existing technology and infrastructure
(15) our ability to maintain the listing of our Class A common stock and warrants on The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC
